purpose: Choose an S0-only price-independent ticket-selection threshold using PRE-side coverage only, not performance.
population: Usable PRE-only races from exact locked NEXTGEN5000 positions 2001..5000; expected approximately 2964 races after fail-closed exclusions.
deterministic_choice_rule: Split usable PRE races chronologically into an earlier half and later half by race_date then race_id.
For gap threshold <3 first, scan probability thresholds from 0.40 downward.
Choose the first (strictest) threshold with at least 200 selected races total AND at least 75 selected races in each half.
If no <3 candidate qualifies, repeat the same scan with gap <5.
If still none qualifies, repeat with no score-gap restriction.
If no candidate reaches coverage requirements, declare NO_S0_COVERAGE_RULE rather than lower probability below 0.20.
reason_for_coverage_targets: Targets are chosen before outcome access to yield enough selections for block-level hit-rate and stability diagnostics while preserving a reasonably selective rule.
